Let's begin with some basic body parts. The root of a medical word is usually a body part. Bone is oste Muscle is myo Nerves is neur Skin is derm The root of echo cardio ogram is cardio . It means heart. Here are some roots for your heart and blood vessels. Your heart is cardio Your veins and arteries are vas or vasc The system of heart and blood vessels is sometimes called the cardiovascular system Here are more roots for your heart and blood vessels.
